tool_schemas.name: read_context
tool_schemas.description: Reads the requested file or directory and returns its contents as context, applying built-in ignores (for common VCS, dependency, build, and IDE artifact paths), optional extension filtering, and optional recursive traversal; if the selected content exceeds the size limit it is split and this call returns only the requested 0-based chunkNumber. Pagination is by chunk number: call get_chunk_count with the same parameters to discover the total chunks, then fetch each chunk with read_context. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if path is missing/invalid, fileTypes is not a string or array of strings, encoding/maxSize/recursive/chunkNumber are invalid, or chunkNumber is out of range; raises NOT_FOUND if the path does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read the repository content.

path.description: Path to file or directory to read

maxSize.description: Maximum file size in bytes. Files larger than this will be chunked.

recursive.description: Whether to read directories recursively (includes subdirectories)

fileTypes.description: File extension(s) to include WITHOUT dots (e.g. ["ts", "js", "py"] or just "ts"). Empty/undefined means all files.

chunkNumber.description: Which chunk to return (0-based). Use with get_chunk_count to handle large files/directories.

tool_schemas.name: get_chunk_count
tool_schemas.description: Computes and returns the total number of 0-based chunks that read_context would produce for the same path and filter parameters, without returning the content itself. Use this to page through large files or directory reads by requesting chunkNumber 0..(count-1) from read_context. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if path is missing/invalid or the supplied encoding/maxSize/recursive/fileTypes are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the path does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to access the repository content.

maxSize.description: Maximum file size in bytes. Files larger than this will be chunked.

recursive.description: Whether to read directories recursively (includes subdirectories)

fileTypes.description: File extension(s) to include WITHOUT dots (e.g. ["ts", "js", "py"] or just "ts"). Empty/undefined means all files.

tool_schemas.name: set_profile
tool_schemas.description: Sets the active context-generation profile to the named profile and returns the updated active profile state. This affects subsequent profile-based operations (for example, generating repository context from the current profile rules). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if profile_name is missing or empty; raises NOT_FOUND if no profile with that name exists; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to change the active profile; raises CONFLICT if the requested profile cannot be activated due to an incompatible or locked server state.

profile_name.description: Name of the profile to activate

tool_schemas.name: get_profile_context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the repository context selected by the currently active profile, optionally refreshing the profile’s file selection first when refresh=true. Results are returned as a single context payload (not chunk-paged via this endpoint). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if refresh is not a boolean; raises NOT_FOUND if no active profile is set; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read profile-derived context; raises CONFLICT if a refresh is requested but the server cannot refresh selection in the current state.

refresh.description: Whether to refresh file selection before generating context

tool_schemas.name: generate_outline
tool_schemas.description: Generates and returns a structural outline for the specified source file (for supported languages such as TypeScript/JavaScript and Python), including high-level constructs like imports, classes, and functions. The response contains the extracted outline for that file path. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if path is missing/invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read the file; raises UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE if the file type is not supported for outlining; raises CONFLICT if the file cannot be outlined due to an invalid state (for example, the path resolves to a directory).

path.description: Path to the file to analyze

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption for this File Context Server tenant. Refuses requests with INVALID_AUTH if the credential is missing/expired and FORBIDDEN if the credential is not permitted to access this service.

apiKey.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate with the File Context Server.

tool_schemas.name: list_repositories
tool_schemas.description: Lists repositories visible to the caller, with optional filtering by status and name. Returns a paginated result set. Refuses with INVALID_AUTH/FORBIDDEN if the credential is not authorized.

apiKey.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate with the File Context Server.

nameQuery.description: Case-insensitive substring match on repository name.

tool_schemas.name: create_repository
tool_schemas.description: Creates a repository record and returns it. The server normalizes and validates repo_root, and may immediately schedule an initial inventory scan. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid inputs, CONFLICT if a repository with the same name already exists for the tenant, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create repositories.

apiKey.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate with the File Context Server.

repo_root.description: Absolute path to the repository root on the server/agent host. All path inputs are resolved under this root; traversal attempts are rejected.

active_profile_id.description: Optional profile id to set as active for this repository. Must belong to the same repository and be status='active'.

tool_schemas.name: scan_repository
tool_schemas.description: Scans/refreshes the repository file inventory (repo_files) under repo_root, applying default ignore rules and upserting by (repository_id, relative_path). Files removed from disk are transitioned to status='missing' (not deleted). Returns the updated repository scan metadata. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot scan, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid options.

apiKey.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate with the File Context Server.

full.description: If true, performs a full rescan of the repository root; if false, may use incremental strategies where supported.

force.description: If true, forces a scan even if the repository is disabled; may still refuse if policy forbids.

tool_schemas.name: list_repo_files
tool_schemas.description: Lists indexed repository files/directories from the repo_files inventory with filtering and pagination. This is inventory-only (does not read file contents). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot view the repository.

apiKey.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate with the File Context Server.

repository_id.description: Repository id whose inventory to list.

prefix.description: Optional relative path prefix to scope results (e.g., "src/"), normalized and treated as a directory prefix.

status.description: Filter by one or more repo_files.status values.

is_directory.description: If set, filters to directories (true) or files (false).

extensions.description: Filter to file extensions WITHOUT leading dots (normalized to lowercase).

tool_schemas.name: create_profile
tool_schemas.description: Creates a context-selection profile for a repository and returns it. Profiles define include/exclude globs, extension filters, and defaults used by get_profile_context. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid globs/extensions/defaults, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot manage profiles.

apiKey.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate with the File Context Server.

repository_id.description: Repository id this profile belongs to.

description.description: Optional description of the profile purpose.

include_globs.description: Glob patterns to include (evaluated under repo_root). Empty means include all (subject to excludes and ignore rules).

exclude_globs.description: Glob patterns to exclude (evaluated under repo_root).

include_extensions.description: Allowed extensions WITHOUT leading dots (normalized to lowercase). Empty means all extensions.

recursive_default.description: Default recursive behavior when generating profile context.

max_size_default_bytes.description: Default max size in bytes enforced for profile context generation.

encoding_default.description: Default encoding used for reads when a caller does not override it.

metadata.name: File Context Server
metadata.description: This backend stores repository file inventory, content snapshots, and derived artifacts (chunked context payloads and code outlines) used by the File Context Server tools.
